qt: to the Commission Hilde Vautmans (Renew) Subject:

Pursuant to Annex IV to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/404, registered horses from Brazil are only to be imported into the European Union from the states of Paraná and Rio de Janeiro (zone BR-1). The State of São Paulo, where, according to representatives of the horse sector, around 70 % of Brazilian show jumpers and racehorses are kept, falls outside this zone. The exclusion dates back to 2008, following an established case of glanders. This restriction constitutes a significant obstacle to the international horse trade and participation in international equestrian events. A revision could open up new economic opportunities for both the European and Brazilian equine sectors, without prejudice to the necessary animal health guarantees. In view of this: 1.
Is the Commission prepared to reassess the current exclusion of São Paulo, taking into account the current epidemiological situation and the applicable animal health requirements?
What concrete steps must the Brazilian authorities take and what veterinary guarantees must they provide for São Paulo to be included in zone BR-1 once again?
Will the Commission actively engage with the Brazilian authorities on this matter in order to investigate a possible reopening of this trade route?
